**New here?** The optional [Primer](primer.qmd) takes about two hours: five short browser labs and nine slides to try before day 1. Nothing in it is assessed.

**Labs on your own computer:** download [Course-Labs.zip](https://github.com/astevegreen/blockchain-technology-course/releases/latest/download/Course-Labs.zip), then follow [Run the labs on your computer](run-labs.qmd): install Docker Desktop once, double-click one file, press Start.

The course runs ten days. Week 1 (days 1 to 5) teaches how blockchains, wallets, tokens and exchanges work; week 2 (days 6 to 10) is tracing practice, one scenario a day. Days 1 to 9 each have three lessons in the morning (day 1 adds the welcome first), taken in the order listed, and a lab in the afternoon; day 10 has none.

## Day 1: Reading the ledger

::: {#day1_listing}
:::

**Lab:** Explorer worksheet in Otterscan, opened by The Insider and a terminal orientation; then a transaction signed and sent to a node on the course's own chain.

**Browser lab** (Keys, secp256k1 and Addresses): [Digital Signatures and Asymmetric Encryption Lab](/assets/labs/signatures/)

## Day 2: Bitcoin and wallets

::: {#day2_listing}
:::

**Lab:** Wallet walkthrough on the course's own chain: a wallet made from a seed phrase, its derived addresses and a 2-of-3 multi-sig spend, each read in the explorer.

## Day 3: Ethereum and tokens

::: {#day3_listing}
:::

**Lab:** A token contract read, then an NFT minted on the course's own chain and read in Otterscan.

**Browser labs:**

* [Reading a Contract With No Source](/assets/labs/ether_evm/index.html) (Accounts, the EVM and Transactions)

## Day 4: DEXs, Layer 2s and bridges

::: {#day4_listing}
:::

**Lab:** A DEX swap on the course's own chain, the pool's price read before and after, then a token bridged and both sides read.

**Browser lab** (Mempool, MEV and DEX Trades): [MEV Builders, Relays, and Proposer Strategy Lab](/assets/labs/ether_mev/mev_builders.html)

## Day 5: Exchanges and the rules

::: {#day5_listing}
:::

**Lab:** On a Tron snapshot: a USDT transfer, an exchange deposit and its sweep, and an issuer freeze; then the instructor's Hyperledger Fabric demo.

## Day 6: Tracing Bitcoin

::: {#day6_listing}
:::

**Lab:** A Bitcoin trace: each link with its heuristic, its known false positives and a confidence.

## Day 7: Where the trace goes dark

::: {#day7_listing}
:::

**Lab:** A CoinJoin and mixer trace: where the trace stops, and what still shows.

## Day 8: Ethereum attacks and the loot

::: {#day8_listing}
:::

**Lab:** A cross-chain trace that opens with one exploit contract read and runs through at least one swap and one bridge.

**Browser lab** (Bytecode and Decompiling): [Reading a Contract With No Source](/assets/labs/ether_evm/index.html)

**Browser lab** (Reentrancy): [The vault that paid twice](/assets/labs/the-vault-that-paid-twice/index.html)

## Day 9: The threat picture

::: {#day9_listing}
:::

**Lab:** A Tron stablecoin trace ending in an exposure summary: the deposit, told apart from the exchange's sweep, and whether the funds can be frozen.

## Day 10: Post-test, then a final trace

No lessons. The morning is a review session for open questions, then the post-test. The afternoon is one unguided tracing scenario, after which each student explains to an instructor what they found and how confident they are.

## Lessons outside the ten-day schedule

These lessons come from the course's earlier, section-by-section layout. The schedule above absorbed some of their slides and does not use the rest. They stay on the site because the glossary, the mind map and the primer link into them; they are not part of the ten days.

::: {#other_listing}
:::

### Browser labs for these lessons

* Hashing and Merkle Trees (02-CP): [Interactive Hash Microlab](/assets/labs/micro-hashing/), [Merkle Tree Microlab](/assets/labs/merkle-trees/)
* Distributed Systems (01-DS): [Centralized and Peer-to-Peer Network Lab](/assets/labs/distributed-systems/distributed_systems_lab.html)
* Distributed Ledgers (04-DS): [Tamper-Evident Ledger Lab](/assets/labs/tamper-ledger/tamper_ledger_lab.html)
* Proof of Work and Security (02-CM): [Proof-of-Work Mining Simulator](/assets/labs/POW_mining_micro/)
